alerts.title: Iran war live: US bombs Iran, Tehran retaliates on Gulf neighbours, Jordan
alerts.why: Direct US-Iran military conflict and regional retaliation threaten critical Gulf oil chokepoints, triggering massive safe-haven flows and supply disruption fears.

alerts.title: Brent rises more than 2% following tit-for-tat strikes by the U.S. and Iran
alerts.why: Direct military escalation between the U.S. and Iran in the Middle East raises supply disruption fears, driving safe-haven gold and crude up.

alerts.title: Oil rises following tit-for-tat strikes by the U.S. and Iran
alerts.why: Direct military escalation between the U.S. and Iran in the Middle East heightens geopolitical risk, threatening supply disruptions and boosting safe havens.

alerts.title: US goes tanker-for-tanker with Iran
alerts.why: US strikes on Iranian tankers near the Strait of Hormuz drastically escalate geopolitical risk, threatening crucial oil chokepoints and boosting safe-haven gold.

alerts.title: Hormuz Shipping Slumps as U.S.-Iran Strikes Rattle Oil Markets
alerts.why: Severe tanker traffic slump in the Strait of Hormuz due to U.S.-Iran strikes creates immediate physical supply disruption fears, driving both safe-haven gold and crude up.

alerts.title: Iran says two tankers have hit Hormuz naval mines, attacks regional targets in retaliation to U.S. strikes
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz mine hits threaten vital crude chokepoints and spark severe supply shock fears amid direct US-Iran military escalation.

alerts.title: Video: US energy chief in Venezuela to sign controversial oil deal
alerts.why: US energy deal with Venezuela signals potential lifting of sanctions, increasing global crude supply and putting downward pressure on oil prices.

alerts.title: Iran, US exchange new attacks: Who was hit in latest strikes?
alerts.why: Direct military escalation involving Iran and US across the Middle East threatens critical Strait of Hormuz oil chokepoint and sparks safe-haven flows.

alerts.title: Diesel Cracks Hit Record Highs as Global Fuel Squeeze Deepens
alerts.why: Middle East escalation, Russian diesel ban, and refinery attacks tighten global fuel markets, supporting both crude and gold prices.

alerts.title: U.S., Iran trade more strikes as Hormuz tensions simmer
alerts.why: Direct military escalation between the U.S. and Iran threatening the Strait of Hormuz creates severe supply disruption fears and drives safe-haven demand.

alerts.title: Qatar and UAE Turn to Rare LNG Ship Transfers as Hormuz Crisis Drags On
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz crisis persisting with rare LNG ship transfers highlights severe regional supply bottlenecks, boosting safe-haven gold and energy risk premiums.

itemsSent.title: Iran urges US to honour commitments under MoU
itemsSent.why: Strait of Hormuz tensions raise geopolitical risk premium, supporting both safe-haven gold and crude oil supply fears.

itemsSent.title: Who is Alejandro Betancourt, ex-Chavez ally now Trump’s Venezuela oil man?
itemsSent.why: Appointment of a new joint oil venture leader signals potential resumption of Venezuelan crude flows, increasing global supply.

itemsSent.title: Gold price erases 2026 gains as Fed hike bets climb to 70%, silver slides
itemsSent.why: Rising Fed rate hike bets strengthen the dollar and increase opportunity costs, pressuring gold prices while having little direct oil impact.

itemsSent.title: A war that won’t end is sending up bond yields and complicating matters for the Fed, which could face a close call on a rate hike at its upcoming meeting www.wsj.com/economy/cent...
itemsSent.why: Higher bond yields driven by sticky inflation and Fed rate hike risks increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold.

itemsSent.title: Bessent Says Strait of Hormuz Obsolete Within Two Years
itemsSent.why: Long-term pipeline bypass plans would eliminate the major geopolitical risk premium currently supporting crude prices, though implementation takes years.

itemsSent.title: Tropical Storm Edouard Forecast Discussion Number 6
itemsSent.why: Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall in Louisiana, potentially causing temporary offshore oil production shut-ins and refinery disruptions, providing a short-term bullish impulse for crude.

itemsSent.title: Trump to meet with U.S. oil refiners as White House pushes to lower gas prices
itemsSent.why: Meeting with refiners to lower gas prices signals policy pressure on crude demand and refining margins, bearish for crude.

itemsSent.title: U.S. Crude Inventories Drop amid Continued SPR Draws
itemsSent.why: API reported a 2.6M barrel crude inventory drop alongside continued SPR draws, providing modest short-term support for oil prices.

itemsSent.title: UK Natural Gas Prices Surge
itemsSent.why: US-Iran tensions threaten Middle East energy supplies, driving safe-haven gold demand and lifting crude alongside natural gas.

itemsSent.title: Eurozone inflation hits a Middle East war high, but core pressures remain contained
itemsSent.why: Rising energy prices from intensifying Gulf conflict drive Eurozone inflation, supporting safe-haven gold and oil supply risk premiums.
